name: Author through verified landing
description: Create a change, obtain human release, and retain delivery responsibility through review, repairs, and verified landing.
when_to_use: Use for an authorized PR/CL authoring workflow with human release and subsequent conditional merge, when the harness supplies provider tools and a bounded babysitting skill.

stages.title: Author {goal}
stages.description: Implement and verify {goal}. Create the authorized provider object, bind the delivery commitment to its exact reference/revision, and complete the producer handoff.
acceptance: Requested change is tested and uploaded
Provider reference and revision are bound to the published delivery commitment

stages.title: Human release for {goal}
stages.description: Present a structured U11 brief and obtain the human's scoped release for review and continuing remediation/conditional merge. Link the decision to the continuation before completing this gate.
acceptance: Human receives background, option consequences, authority scope, and separated evidence
The versioned human answer authorizes the chosen continuation and governs its task

stages.title: Carry {goal} through verified landing
stages.description: Read the current decision and commitment. Use {babysit_skill} for bounded review/comment/CI/conflict handling through {provider}. Wait durably between checks. Record trusted evidence and a scoped merge effect; complete only after the commitment is satisfied by provider read-back in {environment}.
acceptance: Every comment is substantively addressed under the reviewed workflow
Applicable reviewer approval and exact-revision checks permit merge
All provider effects are reconciled and landing is verified
